en_ops.new: When He shows up, it’s gonna be amazing. People who were blind will be able to see, and those who were deaf will hear everything. People who couldn't walk will be jumping around like deer, and those who couldn't speak will be singing their hearts out. Water will start flowing in the driest places, turning hot sand into a cool, refreshing oasis, and thirsty ground into a splashing fountain. Even the wild animals will have plenty to drink, and the dead grasslands will become super lush.

en_ops.new: So, in King Hezekiah's fourteenth year, King Sennacherib of Assyria rolled up on all of Judah's fortified cities and just took them. Then the Assyrian king sent his top general, the 'Rabshekah,' with a massive army from Lachish to Jerusalem to confront King Hezekiah. The general posted up at the aqueduct by the upper pool, right on the road to the public laundry. Three of Hezekiah's guys went out to meet him: Eliakim son of Hilkiah, in charge of the palace; Shebna, the secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the official historian.
Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah answered the Rabshekah, 'Hey, can you please talk to us in Aramaic? We get that. Don't speak Hebrew where all these people can hear you.'

Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace manager, Shebna, the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the court historian, tore their clothes because they were so defeated and upset. They went back and told Hezekiah everything the Rabshekah had said.

title: Assyria's King Tries to Cancel Hezekiah
